items.title: DLSS 5 Neural Rendering in Returnal — measured, not eyeballed
body: DLSS 5 is not out yet. Its runtime leaked early, the modding community wired it into a few dozen games, and the internet filled up with before-and-after screenshots. I stopped looking at screenshots and measured it instead — every control, every value, on one game, at 4K, in floating point.

The headline: switching it on is a large, real change — roughly +50% micro-detail on the character and +29% on the environment. Almost everything else is smaller than you would assume. Of the eleven controls the mod exposes, only two changed the picture in a way that survived a properly measured noise floor. Three did nothing at all. One made the image visibly worse at its top setting, in a way the obvious quality metric rewards.
The full write-up has the method, every measurement, the settings that came out of it, and the five results that turned out to be wrong along the way.
